_comment: MODERATE Cursor sandbox.json. Deny-by-default network with common package registries and git hosts. Shared build cache on for productivity. Temp writes allowed. readBoundary workspace (Cursor 3.23+). WHAT: asks before the agent reads or searches outside the workspace, and limits what a sandboxed command can read. WHY: the product default, system, reads SSH keys, cloud credentials, and other home-directory files without asking. BREAKS: removing this key, or setting system, restores those silent reads. It does not apply while Run Everything is on, and it does not block writes outside the workspace (External-File Protection does that). Do not allowlist ~/.ssh or ~/.aws. The team dashboard Read Controls setting is the lock a user cannot override by editing this file.
